scope: Official motion references visually inspected for original Nearpane film; copyrighted clips for internal reference only, excluded from production assets. Reference-direction notes are research proposals, not a description or certification of the final39-second edit; approved-edit.json governs the delivered film.

references.title: Introducing Linear Agent
references.verified_by: Downloaded official MP4 and inspected 12 timestamped frames across full duration; no claim of audio listening.

observations.description: 产品从第一幕就在画面中；黑底斜置界面由窗口局部移动到右下角输入框，光线与焦点引导视线。
同一任务连续展开：输入、结果、计划、创建项目；镜头在界面内部切换尺度，画面主角始终是产品的因果变化。
产品界面退场后保持黑色留白，先字标再图标，片尾拥有清楚驻留时间。

use_for_nearpane: 开场直接看到产品用途；界面动作构成叙事，文字只辅助。
只对有信息价值的操作近拍，镜头退出时保留歌词板和桌面的空间关系。
do_not_copy: 不沿用黑底、强倾斜、明显失焦，它们会降低本片歌词可读性。

references.title: Meet the all-new Things (official site remastered film)
references.verified_by: Downloaded official MP4 and inspected 12 timestamped frames across full duration; no claim of audio listening.

observations.description: 大面积浅灰背景，单个设备由远景进入清晰界面，软阴影建立质感。
实际UI在局部特写中承担视觉吸引力：侧栏、完成状态、编辑区；有限的品牌色出现在真实功能细节。
设备边缘与内容同时保留，交替使用整体与细节构图；避免始终贴满屏幕。
浅色清晰品牌收尾，单一图标+名称，没有重复功能清单。

use_for_nearpane: 浅暖灰环境、真实柔影、安静留白；UI文字需要在清晰平面显示。
镜头节奏来自宽景/近景/动作完成后的短暂停留，不依赖轮番的标题卡。
do_not_copy: 无需模拟手机硬件或照搬Things蓝色。Nearpane本体是桌面歌词板。

references.title: Apple Music Sing official feature animation (not a standalone launch film)
references.verified_by: Downloaded official MP4 and inspected 12 timestamped frames over 4.97 s; HTML identifies the animation as synced lyrics. Clip is a site feature loop, not a full launch film.

observations.description: 当前歌词高对比突出，前后句降对比；画面及专辑封面稳定。
歌词换行和高亮变化即为主要动态，镜头本身无需运动才能传达音乐同步。
产品功能内的反应图标沿画面上升，歌词依然是可识别的信息层。

use_for_nearpane: 歌词本身即是叙事：已授权真实歌曲的歌词按音乐变化，先保持稳定机位让观众读到一句。
上下文歌词应退到次要层，视觉焦点不与鼠标、镜头、字幕同时争抢。
do_not_copy: 不添加原产品不存在的逐字卡拉OK高亮或爱心反应。只使用Nearpane实际支持的逐行变化。
不使用Apple的歌曲、封面、原片或字体文件作为本片素材。

recommended_direction.concept: 让音乐，留在手边。 / Keep the music close.
recommended_direction.visual_language: Warm off-white desktop; a single muted cool accent; actual product UI at readable scale; edge light and real shadow; almost no decorative animation.
recommended_direction.narrative: Research proposal, superseded by config/approved-edit.json after actual product verification. The final film is a product preview: real Music and QQ playback, continued lyrics while reading, native hover, brief native host ordering and screenshot intake, verified official website.
recommended_direction.camera: Establish desk relationship once, then move smoothly to panel. One 6–8s unbroken experience shot. Static framing while the key lyric changes. Return to spatial context before outro.
recommended_direction.attention_rule: 同一瞬间只让歌词、鼠标或镜头中的一个承担主动态，其他稳定。
recommended_direction.brand_rule: 早段只以小型Nearpane标识建立归属，片尾主品牌Nearpane；LyricTile只解释歌词板，不作为独立下载。
recommended_direction.anti_slideshow_rule: 不得用6张静态卡片加淡入淡出构成整片。至少一个连续交互镜头要有时间因果：播放→出现→歌词变化→悬停→控制。
